responsibility: This definition module declares the simple terminal I/O façade used by the legacy compatibility libraries. It exports character and string read/write operations, nonblocking key-status querying, a placeholder ReadAgain hook, and newline output, all intended to be implemented through the lower-level Termbase dispatch layer.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Terminal pair: it declares the simple terminal façade procedures that sit above Termbase, while Terminal.mod contains the forwarding and line/string handling behavior.
